title: Months where cancellations spiked
statementMd:
List months (YYYY-MM) in which more than 5% of departing flights were cancelled. Show month and the percentage rounded to 1 decimal.

Expected columns: `month`, `cancelled_pct`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Average a 0/1 flag per month and filter in `HAVING`.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', depart_date) AS month, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(status = 'cancelled') / COUNT(*), 1) AS cancelled_pct FROM flights GROUP BY month HAVING 100.0 * SUM(status = 'cancelled') / COUNT(*) > 5;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
